items.text: Fixed disappearing/reappearing on stairs in nuclear missile silo by adding an extra CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride.
Prevented underground train tunnels from spawning too close in canyon areas, eliminating rare canyon-bottom deaths.
Adjusted coconut tree network range, corrected coconut spawn chance to 25%, and increased apple/beehive spawn chance on oak trees to 25% (up from 15%).
Resolved multiple issues with the Frankenstein pet: sinking terrain, invisible ranged attacks, accidental kicks, and window clipping.
Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle when preparing newly added teas.
Overhauled Mixing/Cooking UI: added a separate "currently craftable" list, an "All" button, and toggle-group category buttons that show only the selected category.
Restored helicopter rumble sound by adding a missing IsOn check.
Fixed visual bug where minigun bullets appeared to pass through surfaces within ~2 m of the player’s view.
Unified lighthouse repair progress: repairing any lighthouse contributes to a shared resource and repair pool for all lighthouses.

2026-10-19.summary:
### World & Environment
- Fixed disappearing/reappearing on stairs in nuclear missile silo by adding an extra CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride.
- Prevented underground train tunnels from spawning too close in canyon areas, eliminating rare canyon-bottom deaths.
- Adjusted coconut tree network range, corrected coconut spawn chance to 25%, and increased apple/beehive spawn chance on oak trees to 25% (up from 15%).

### Pets & Animals
- Resolved multiple issues with the Frankenstein pet: sinking terrain, invisible ranged attacks, accidental kicks, and window clipping.

### Crafting & UI
- Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle when preparing newly added teas.
- Overhauled Mixing/Cooking UI: added a separate "currently craftable" list, an "All" button, and toggle-group category buttons that show only the selected category.

### Audio & Visual Effects
- Restored helicopter rumble sound by adding a missing IsOn check.
- Fixed visual bug where minigun bullets appeared to pass through surfaces within ~2 m of the player’s view.

### Structures & Resources
- Unified lighthouse repair progress: repairing any lighthouse contributes to a shared resource and repair pool for all lighthouses.
